sourceTitle: Does God Exist?  (Frank Turek vs Dennis Nørmark)
eventDateBasis: Uploader description states March 2014, Skywalk Church, Randers, Denmark. The supplied upload is dated 2017-08-12.

sourceEvidence.coverage: The sole public English automatic-caption track spans the recording, with both opening presentations, rebuttals, dialogue and both closing statements. This establishes timed coverage, not verbatim accuracy. Danish introductory announcements are poorly recognized as English and are not motion-level evidence.
limitations: Automatic recognition errors affect names, technical terms, some negations and mixed-speaker dialogue. Preserve raw words; do not penalize speakers for recognition corruption.
Opening Danish logistics are not reliable English text. No substantive assessment inference should come from that passage.
Caption overlap around speaker handoffs requires careful evidence ownership and below-high-confidence audio checks if selected.
The four gaps longer than ten seconds coincide with transitions or applause in the caption context; their non-substantive status has not yet been independently audio-verified.

eligibilityDecision.reason: The moderator supplies recurring independent challenges. The amputee contrast and specific unanswered-prayer challenge are not established as merely duplicating a primary-speaker argument. Uncertainty on the no-unique-load-bearing-argument condition fails the automatic exception regardless of the duration percentage.

neededUserDecision.concreteProposedException: Score only Frank Turek and Dennis Nørmark across the complete substantive debate. Retain Adam Holm’s interventions as context; assess the primary speakers’ own replies. Never assign Holm’s arguments to either speaker or score Holm. Account for unequal questioning and disclose the exception to readers.
neededUserDecision.proposedReaderDisclosure: By explicit editorial approval, this assessment scores only Frank Turek and Dennis Nørmark across the substantive debate. Moderator Adam Holm contributes independent arguments and challenges, which remain context; the debaters’ own replies remain eligible for assessment. No moderator argument is credited to either debater. Unequal questioning is considered when selecting moves and evaluating opportunities to respond. This is a recording-specific exception to the ordinary two-speaker source rule.
